title: DL Sebastian Joseph-Day agrees to two-year deal with Steelers

sources.title: DL Sebastian Joseph-Day agrees to two-year deal with Steelers
sources.description: Free agent defensive lineman Sebastian Joseph-Day is signing a two-year, $11 million deal with the Steelers, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
